environment.description: Flask application deployed on a single EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2), behind a classic ELB with TCP passthrough on port 443. No additional middleware or filtering. SQLite database stored on local EBS volume with default file permissions. Application runs as ec2-user with standard IAM instance profile for CloudWatch logging only.

config.infrastructure: Single EC2 t3.medium, Classic ELB TCP passthrough
config.network: Public subnet, security group allows 0.0.0.0/0 on port 443
